The increase of strength of Nb by W addition is mainly due to the combined effect of size and modulus misfit associated with Nb and W atoms (rNb = 145 pm and rW = 136 pm; GNb = 38 GPa and GW = 160 GPa).
The additional strength observed in the Nb–W–Zr alloy as compared to the Nb–W alloy might have come from the grain boundary strengthening and solid solution strengthening of Nb–W by Zr.
